about.title: I draw things.
paragraphs: I am Jordan Beattie, a digital illustrator on the Gold Coast, Australia. I draw the characters I grew up with: comic-book heroes, the villains who are more fun than the heroes, and the horror faces that kept me up at night.
Everything here is drawn digitally, built up from rough sketch to ink to colour. Every few years I redraw an old piece to see how far the work has come.
